# Case Study

`saas/case-study` &middot; section-level &middot; category: saas

## Purpose

A case study teaser: the customer, a headline, a summary, up to three results as big numbers, an optional quote and a button.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `customer` | text |  |
| `headline` | text |  |
| `results` | stats |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `summary` | text |  |
| `quote` | text |  |
| `person` | text |  |
| `role` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Outcome-first case study on the surface color.
- **tinted**: On the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX 0 @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Each stats row is a table with exact widths. | Fine. Stats sit two per row on phones through a media query. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('saas/case-study', {
  "customer": "Northwind Studio",
  "headline": "How Northwind cut onboarding from 3 weeks to 4 days",
  "summary": "A 60-person agency replaced four tools with one workspace and gave every new client a live project on day one.",
  "results": [
    {
      "value": "4 days",
      "label": "Client onboarding"
    },
    {
      "value": "50%",
      "label": "Fewer status meetings"
    },
    {
      "value": "12 hrs",
      "label": "Saved per project"
    }
  ],
  "quote": "It is the first tool the whole team actually uses.",
  "person": "Dana Whitfield",
  "role": "Head of Operations",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Read the case study",
    "href": "https://example.com/customers/northwind"
  }
}) ]]
```
